scope:
Fresh stock comparison for the final qualified #418 scientific source.

Seven interleaved pairs at all mandatory small points and large energy/force
points retain the original controls and fixture-specific gates. This is one
predeclared campaign after a changed large-case implementation, not a retry of
earlier failed samples. Prior #206 failures remain retained and unresolved.
Cold/changed geometry, unequal auxiliaries, direct gates and full resource
accounting remain separate requirements; this driver cannot close #206 alone.
